BOLD · TANGY · TRADITIONAL

Traditional Punjabi Achaar

Our house-special mix achar is prepared using traditional Punjabi methods that bring together bold spices and classic flavours. Rich, tangy, and perfectly balanced, it adds depth to every meal and pairs beautifully with parathas, dal, and classic Punjabi dishes.

SWEET · AROMATIC · REFRESHING

Traditional Punjabi Mukhwas

Our house-special Mukhwas is a thoughtfully prepared blend of sweet fennel seeds and colourful traditional elements. Lightly sweet, refreshing, and aromatic, it helps digestion and serves as a traditional mouth freshener after meals.
